cases.rationale: Every step is individually legitimate; only the ORDER is the attack, and order is reconstructed from self-reported correlation. Blocking on it would let an attacker halt someone else's agent by forging a chain, so it raises an incident and does not refuse.
cases.technique: Read sensitive data, compress it, ship it outside the estate.

cases.rationale: Scores CRITICAL because the privilege change makes the first two steps durable. Still self-reported correlation, so same posture: full-severity evidence to a human, no automatic action.
cases.technique: Read a secret, log in with it, then grant itself a role.

cases.rationale: Uploading, then compressing, then reading is not an exfiltration. A rule that fired here would be matching a set, and would flag ordinary work constantly.
cases.technique: Confirm the detector matches a SEQUENCE and not a set.

cases.rationale: Two of three steps is not the pattern. Firing on a prefix would flag every agent that ever read a file and compressed it.
cases.technique: Confirm a prefix of a rule does not fire it.

cases.rationale: The predecessor let an ingest-role key post its own severity. Severity is computed from the policy, never accepted from the caller, so the claim has no effect at all -- which is why nothing is detected and nothing is refused.
cases.technique: Manufacture a CRITICAL incident by asserting one.

limits: A green row means one attack was stopped, not that the technique is impossible. INCONCLUSIVE and NOT_RUN are NOT defences: an attack that failed to launch produces the same observable as one that was blocked, so `defence_rate` returns None while either is present rather than quoting a percentage of the cases that happened to work. Read `techniques_not_attempted` before reading any total.
rate_refusal_reason: 5 cases is below the 30 needed to quote a proportion. A small ratio reads as certainty and is a wide interval.
techniques_not_attempted: AML.T0010 ML supply chain compromise (covered by scanners, not by attack)
AML.T0018 backdoor ML model (no model training surface in this product)
AML.T0024 exfiltration via ML inference API (no inference API is exposed)
AML.T0043 craft adversarial data (Sentinel classifies events, not images)
ASI03 identity impersonation at the signature layer (needs a key-custody test harness that does not exist yet)
ASI10 rogue agent persistence across tenant boundaries (needs a multi-tenant soak, which is Phase 69 and UNVERIFIED)
